messages:

Cc: Connor Todd <ctodd@brightpathhealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro call follow-up — POC goals and timeline

Thanks Hannah — quick follow up from our side after the discovery call. We want to make sure the POC covers three items: (1) prompt accuracy on our clinical triage prompts, (2) end-to-end latency under 250ms p95 for short chats, and (3) a 2-week load test reflecting peak clinic hours.

Two asks from us before kickoff:
- Can Redwood provide a recommended daily token budget and a recommended rate limit profile for a Hosted trial vs Dedicated trial?
- Can we schedule a hands-on prompt review + routing/load test planning session next week? Our team prefers mornings (PST).

Connor and I are available Tue/Wed/Thu AM next week. Also attaching our internal sample prompts for the clinic flow.

Attachments: sample-prompts.docx

—Amy
Amy Chen
Head of Digital Products | BrightPath Health
amy@brightpathhealth.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Connor Todd <ctodd@brightpathhealth.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro call follow-up — POC goals and timeline

Amy — great summary, thanks. Quick answers up front:
- Hosted trial: recommend starting with a token budget of 250k tokens/day with a soft rate limit of ~20 requests/minute and burst handling enabled. This gets you consistent latency while we tune batching and caching.
- Dedicated trial: for a 2-week focused load test I’d recommend reserving 2x A100-equivalent instances (or equivalent vGPU slots) and a daily token target of 700k tokens/day to simulate peak traffic; we can narrow after the prompt review.

Proposed next steps and calendar options (PST mornings):
- Hands-on prompt review + routing & KV cache setup — Tue 2027-05-25 09:30–11:00 or Wed 2027-05-26 08:30–10:00
- Capacity planning and load-test window planning — Wed 2027-05-26 10:30–11:30 (follow immediately after prompt review if we pick Wed)

I’ve looped in Dylan (runtime lead) and Rishi (capacity/ops) to confirm availability and to prep a draft load-test plan. I’ll attach our POC playbook (v2) and the load-test spreadsheet for your review.

Attachments: poc-playbook-v2.pdf; brightpath-loadtest-plan.xlsx

If the Dedicated route is preferred, we’ll need a quick redline on the proposed quota bump and a brief procurement note for your side (Rishi can outline the minimum SLA we’ll target).

Cheers,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
(h) 415-555-0123
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-05-21T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro call follow-up — POC goals and timeline

Hannah / team — I can make Tue 5/25 09:30 PST. A couple of operational notes to prep:
- For prompt review: please send the worst-case long prompt (clinical note + history) so we can measure tokenization and KV cache benefits.
- For routing: I’ll bring a short demo of model fallback — how we automatically route to a cheaper quantized variant when Dedicated capacity saturates.
- For load tests: we’ll want two windows of 90 minutes each during clinic-hours patterns to simulate ramp and steady-state.

Suggested immediate prework for BrightPath (small, high-impact):
1) Mark 10 representative prompts as HIGH/REGULAR/EDGE.
2) Provide a single-day traffic profile (requests per 15m) so we can sketch a realistic batch-size policy.

I’ll prepare a short runbook for the load test so we can agree on metrics (p95 latency, token/sec, error-rate).

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks

One procurement question for Rishi (cc’d): if we go Dedicated for the 2-week load test, what lead time do you need to provision the reserved capacity and are there minimum commit terms? Also cc’ing Sara from Legal to flag any contract timeline items.

—Amy
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy@brightpathhealth.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-25T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC capacity playbook & hands-on scheduling (BrightPath)

Amy / team — quick procurement/capacity note and confirmation for Wed 2027-05-26 08:30–10:00 PST (I have the slot on my calendar).

Operational answers:
- Lead time: we can provision Dedicated trial capacity in 72 hours for standard GPU pools; for specific region/hardware requests (e.g., single-tenant vGPU flavor) give us 7 business days.
- Minimum commit: for short Dedicated trials we do a 2-week minimum commit for reserved slots (no long-term contract required for the POC), billed pro-rata.
- Quota bump: we can approve a temporary token quota increase to 700k tokens/day for the 2-week window; please confirm expected daily peaks so we can set rate-limit policies.

Requested prework items for the Wed session (we’ll use these to preconfigure the environment):
- BrightPath: single-day traffic export (CSV) + the categorized prompt list
- Redwood: pre-baked Dedicated config and a Hosted fallback policy; runbook for how we’ll switch routing under saturation

I’ve uploaded a draft load-test schedule and a sample canary rollback policy to the shared Drive folder. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B-poc-brightpath (see files: brightpath-loadtest-plan.xlsx, calendar-proposed.ics)

If Legal needs a short form for the 2-week reserved capacity, Marissa can push a POC addendum that keeps liability minimal.

See you Wed 08:30 PST — I’ll lead the capacity section and the quota-ticket creation.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Capacity & Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
